:::{#exr-column-vector-practice}
#### Reading one entry of a column vector of temperatures

A week of daily readings is often stored as a [column vector](#def-column-vector),
with the reading for day $i$ in entry $i$.
The noon temperatures on the Celsius scale on the first four days of a week are

$$
\vx = \sbmat{12 \\ 15 \\ 9 \\ 11}.
$$

Find $x_3$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

In @def-column-vector,
$x_i$ is the entry in position $i$,
counting from the top.

:::

:::
